claims.evidence: No origin marks, import sticker, or provenance shown in either photo; plastic wrap obscures brand/model plate.
No power-on, audio, or video evidence; photos only show the unit wrapped and static.

risks.risk: Unit may not power on or keys/speakers may not work
risks.proof: A video of the keyboard powered on, playing a few notes through its own speakers

risks.risk: No power adapter or stand included, affecting usability and added cost
risks.proof: A photo of the adapter/cable and stand alongside the unit

risks.risk: Hidden scratches, cracks, or key damage under the plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos with the plastic removed, showing full front, back, and key surface close-up

risks.risk: Brand and model unknown, so true market tier and key count can't be confirmed
risks.proof: A clear photo of the brand/model label and a full top-down shot showing all keys
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic unbranded entry-level keyboard

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powered on with sound
Photos with plastic wrap removed, including back and key close-ups
Photo of included power adapter/stand if any
response.reason: The witness confirms it is an electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at worst case (untested, unbranded, no accessories, unknown cosmetic condition) pending the listed proofs.
